name: Sit down

v1.prompt: The cat, standing on all four paws facing right, gets bored and sits down on its haunches in profile: back legs fold, front legs stay straight, tail wraps around the front paws. Ends seated, still, in side view.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: good: stands, then sits in profile with the tail wrapped; rim light/fringe slightly stronger than the painting. (Polling hit a network reset; fetched free with resume.)
suggest: frames 5-15 at 12 fps, then hold frame 24
